questions.question: The bus arrives at 5:30 p.m. Write this time in 24-hour time and explain.
questions.expected_answer: It is after noon, so add 12 to the hour: 5 plus 12 is 17. The time is 17:30.

questions.question: On an analogue clock, the minute hand points to the 9 and the hour hand is between the 7 and the 8. What time is it?
questions.expected_answer: The minute hand on the 9 shows 45 minutes. The hour hand has passed the 7 but not reached the 8, so the time is 7:45, or quarter to eight.

questions.question: Change 21:05 and 09:20 to 12-hour time.
questions.expected_answer: 21:05: the hour is more than 12, so 21 minus 12 is 9, giving 9:05 p.m. 09:20: the hour is less than 12, so it is 9:20 a.m.
